set.body: Evidence: AlignedSharedScoreGlrm accepts already-built block decoders and row codes, then evaluates or encodes; tests manually construct those fitted inputs. Acceptance: add a public joint fit that learns shared row codes and block decoders under declared scaling and penalties; compose the executable GLRM path; retain row alignment and block identities, per-block diagnostics, solver trace and achieved guarantee; demonstrate block permutation and partial-encoding laws on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Make aligned structured multiblock a real joint fit
